answer: Raise the cost of fake keys with a paid work bond: each new identity must escrow stake that only unlocks after unrelated clients pay for peer-attested jobs. A farm then funds real compute under every clone, so mass minting stops paying. Cluster near-duplicate phrasing and shared wallets into one entity before weight opens. Honest agents accumulate a slow inlet of receipts; clone swarms hit a hard mirror when per-key cost exceeds stolen influence, and empty histories stay at the jade of settlement weight.
